info.title: UnfoldX public API
info.summary: Delegate explainer videos to the UnfoldX main agent and follow them to the finished film.
info.description:
The single contract for the `unfoldx` CLI, the `unfoldx-mcp` server and any other client.

* Every response is the `unfoldx.v2` envelope: `data` when `ok` is true, `error` otherwise.
  Responses carry `Cache-Control: no-store`.
* `error.type` is a closed set that clients map to exit codes; `error.code` is the precise reason.
* Public ids only: workspace ids, `run_…`, `<run_id>.video|cover`, `mat_…`, `cred_…`.
* A workspace is one main-agent conversation; a run is one message to it.
* Writes run through the same services as the web. `POST /v2/runs` needs an `Idempotency-Key`
  (the client's command id): the same key and body return the same run, a changed body is 409.
* A route card is answered on the user's behalf only within the credential's budget; above it the
  answer is `needs_input/approval_required` with the `approval_url` where the user confirms.
* Publishing requires explicit publish:confirm scope and a current publish card.
* Clients name themselves on every request with `X-Unfoldx-Client` (`cli` or `mcp`,
  `#/components/parameters/UnfoldxClient`).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: the client's command id; `GET /v2/commands/{key}` finds the run it started

get.summary: The run a command id started (for a client that lost the response). Scope `runs:read`.

post.summary: Answer the run's route, storyboard or publish card. Scope `runs:answer` (publish cards also `publish:confirm`). A route whose hold exceeds the credential's per-run cap, or the last 24 hours' auto-approved holds plus this one exceed the daily cap, is 409 `needs_input/approval_required` with `details.approval_url`; nothing is held and the card stays open on the web.
Stop the run; repeating it, or cancelling a finished run, returns its current state. Scope `runs:cancel`.
A ten-minute signed form to POST one file straight to object storage under the user's own key. Scope `materials:write`. Then call `/v2/materials/{id}/complete`.

get.summary: A material's state. Scope `materials:write`.
get.description: Read an owned material. Requires materials:read.

post.summary: Check the stored object's size and mark the material ready; 409 `upload_incomplete` otherwise.

get.summary: State, the open question and settlement. Scope `runs:read`.

Events after a cursor. `seq` increases but is not contiguous; dedupe by `seq`.
The server answers at once; clients poll. Scope `runs:read`.
Open confirmation cards, oldest first. Scope `runs:read`.
The film's artifacts. `ready` is false until the run completes; earlier films are never returned. Scope `runs:read`.

bearer.description: `ufx_` token from the device login; stored by the server only as a hash.

UnfoldxClient.name: X-Unfoldx-Client
UnfoldxClient.description: the client sending the request: the `unfoldx` CLI or the `unfoldx-mcp` server; the platform shows each credential's connection state per client

route_credit_cap.description: credits one production route may be confirmed for without the user

paid.description: some step it relies on is charged

web_url.description: the page in the UnfoldX web app where the user watches this run and confirms what it asks

answerable.description: false means this card is visible but requires the approval URL

answer_schema.description: JSON Schema for this exact card; false means not answerable

storyboard.description: Editable text only. Answer continue, or {action: narration_patch, patches: [{uid, exact_narration}], deleted_slides: [], inserted_slides: []}.

spoken_text.description: Narration without control markers for human review

approval_url.description: where the user confirms on the web

angles.description: present when the agent offers 2-3 explanation angles; the first is the recommended one, and the answer names one by angle_id

unavailable_reason.description: Why the user cannot pick this route now, on a route with available=false.

hold.description: credits held if this route is chosen

target.description: where a confirmation publishes the film; gallery is the public UnfoldX gallery

film.description: the film a confirmation publishes; if a newer film has been made since, the answer is 409 and the agent must ask again

idempotent_replay.description: true when this command id had already started the run

Answer.description: Use the question answer_schema for card-specific choices and answer_examples for valid actions.

FilmDuration.description: Measured duration is a soft-target fact. The caller decides whether to revise; deviation never fails the job.

SuperfastBilling.description: the job's production hold, read like a run's usage: held until the film settles it or a failure refunds it

credits.description: held amount, or the charge once settled

available.description: credits the account can still spend (open holds already taken out)

held.description: credits held by productions still running

route_credit_cap.description: largest single hold this key may approve by itself

approved_last_24h.description: holds this key approved in the last 24 hours (cancelled runs still count)

next_release_at.description: when the oldest approval in the window stops counting

auto_approve_limit.description: min(route cap, daily remaining, wallet available): the largest route, cover or superfast hold this key can approve now without the user. 0 means every spend needs the user on the web, not that the account cannot spend

unfoldx_credits.description: What this key can still spend today. Read auto_approve_limit before answering a route card, generating covers or submitting superfast: a hold above it comes back approval_required for the user to confirm on the web.

unfoldx_catalog.description: Choices the main agent and the cover/voice tools accept.

unfoldx_workspaces.description: Workspaces (one main-agent conversation each): list them by title or run state, or get one with its runs.

unfoldx_run_get.description: One run (one message to the main agent): its state, progress events after a cursor, open confirmation cards, result, or credit usage; `command` finds the run a submit started when its response was lost.

unfoldx_run_submit.description: Send the main agent a message: a new video, or a follow-up in workspace_id. Choose command_id BEFORE calling and reuse it on every retry.

unfoldx_materials.description: Uploaded materials: search the library, or get one by id.

unfoldx_works.description: Finished works: list them, get one, or list the exports it offers.

unfoldx_share_write.description: Create or revoke the public share link of an owned work.

unfoldx_covers_write.description: Generate covers for a run (held against the key's budget) or select one.

unfoldx_settings_get.description: Read the preferences or the pronunciation dictionary.

unfoldx_settings_update.description: Replace the preferences or the pronunciation dictionary; read its current revision first.

unfoldx_brand_write.description: Create or update a brand kit, or add or update one of its assets.

unfoldx_topics.description: What this account wants covered: the topics it subscribes to, the events it follows and its sources. Pick a subject here before asking for a film; subscribe to keep one.

unfoldx_schedules.description: The account's auto tasks: list, add, edit frequency/scope/cap, pause or delete. Creating one starts nothing and spends nothing; every run stays within the account's cap.

unfoldx_publish.description: Prepare a publish outside the web card: pick platform, title, description and tags, get a one-time handoff link the browser extension fills, then read back what it saw (filled, published with a link, or unverified).
